metadata.title: Project Structure Migration to Feature-First Architecture

story.iWant: the Toubkal Browser codebase to follow feature-first organization patterns
story.soThat: the code is scalable, maintainable, and follows modern best practices for both React/TypeScript and Chromium C++ development
story.tasks: Phase 1: Create New Structure (Foundation) Phase 2: Migrate Features (Privacy & Consent) Phase 3: Extract Shared Code Phase 4: Setup Core Infrastructure Phase 5: Migrate Remaining Features Phase 6: Migrate Tests Phase 7: Cleanup and Documentation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: React/TypeScript Code Migration Core Infrastructure Setup C++ Code Organization Documentation and Validation Testing and Build System

artifact.title: Architecture Overview
artifact.snippet: Current monolithic Chromium-based architecture with React WebUI, Mojo IPC, and C++ backend components. Defines separation between browser process, renderer process, and external components.

artifact.title: Testing Strategy
artifact.section: Unit Testing, Integration Testing, Test Pyramid
artifact.snippet: Comprehensive testing guide with 80% coverage minimum, Vitest for TypeScript, gtest for C++, integration tests for build system validation.

artifact.title: Toubkal Coding Rules
artifact.section: File Naming, Error Handling, Testing Rules
artifact.snippet: Strict coding standards including PascalCase for components, kebab-case for hooks/services, Result<T> pattern, 80% test coverage minimum, proper import aliases.

artifact.title: Privacy & Ethics Policy
artifact.section: Zero Telemetry by Default, Consent-Gated Features
artifact.snippet: Privacy-first design principles ensuring zero telemetry by default, consent-gated diagnostics, and PII protection in all logging and monitoring.

artifact.reason: Current mixed-concern React components that need feature-based organization - includes ConsentBanner, PrivacyDashboard, routing components, and page components
Current generic hooks (use-consent, use-privacy-settings) that need to be moved to feature-specific or shared directories
Current mixed services (privacy-manager, audit-logger, telemetry-manager) that need feature-based organization
Current shared types (PrivacyTypes, TelemetryTypes) that need to be moved to feature-specific or shared directories
Target feature-first structure with features/, shared/, and core/ directories - some basic structure already exists
Existing C++ browser-level code following Brave patterns - should remain in browser/ directory
Existing C++ feature modules following Brave patterns - should remain in components/ directory
Vitest test setup with global mocks and cleanup utilities - needs migration to new structure
Integration tests that need to be migrated to new testing structure

packages.package: TypeScript compiler with strict mode and path mapping for feature-first imports
React framework for UI components in feature-first architecture
Unit and integration testing framework for migrated feature tests
Linting with custom rules for feature-first import validation
GN build system for generating Ninja files with new directory structure
Ninja build tool for compiling migrated code structure

story-context.constraints: Follow feature-first organization patterns Use React best practices and Brave patterns Ensure incremental migration without breaking existing functionality Maintain proper separation between React UI and C++ backend Follow Toubkal coding rules and file naming conventions

tests.standards: Unit tests: Vitest + React Testing Library for migrated feature components and hooks. Integration tests: Validate feature imports and cross-feature communication. E2E tests: Build system validation and import resolution testing. Migration tests: Import path validation and build success verification. 80% minimum test coverage across all migrated features. AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert) for all tests. Result<T> pattern for error handling in migrated services.
tests.locations: src/toubkal/app/features/*/ - Feature-specific unit tests in components/, hooks/, services/ subdirectories src/toubkal/app/shared/ - Shared utility and component tests src/toubkal/tests/unit/ - Migrated unit tests for new structure src/toubkal/tests/integration/ - Integration tests for feature communication and imports src/toubkal/tests/migration/ - Tests specifically for migration validation
tests.ideas: AC1-React-migration: Test that all React components migrate successfully with correct feature-based imports and maintain existing functionality AC2-Core-infrastructure: Validate routing, Mojo bindings, and build configuration work with new structure AC3-C++-organization: Ensure C++ code remains properly organized following Brave patterns and integrates with new React structure AC4-Documentation-validation: Test that all import paths resolve correctly and documentation reflects new structure AC5-Testing-build-system: Validate that all tests pass after migration, build system works, and TypeScript compilation succeeds with new paths
